novel_features.name: Deals gone dark
novel_features.description: List open deals with no call activity in the last N days, so nothing stalls silently.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining deals to their most recent conversation in the local store; the entity-by-entity API exposes no such cross-entity query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs the re-engagement list: which open opportunities have gone quiet.

novel_features.name: Weekly call digest
novel_features.description: Pull every call in a window, grouped by deal, with next steps per deal (summaries appear when conversation detail is synced).
novel_features.rationale: Groups cached conversations by linked deal locally; the web UI is one call at a time and the API has no grouped view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to generate a Monday pipeline review without clicking through every call.

novel_features.name: CRM autofill pending diff
novel_features.description: Show the AI-suggested CRM field updates Sybill generated, as a reviewable field-by-field diff.
novel_features.rationale: crmAutofill suggestions live inside deal-detail payloads; no tool surfaces them as a pending-changes list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before pushing CRM updates, to review what Sybill wants to change.

novel_features.name: Account roll-up
novel_features.description: One offline view per account: call count, open deals by stage, contacts, and last activity.
novel_features.rationale: Joins accounts, conversations, deals, and contacts in the local store; no single API call returns this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to prep a renewal or expansion conversation with full account context.

novel_features.name: Rep activity aggregation
novel_features.description: Per-rep breakdown: calls made, deals touched, and deals gone dark over a window.
novel_features.rationale: SQL group-by over cached conversations and deals by owner; the API exposes no rep-level analytics.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for manager-side coaching prep and pipeline-coverage checks.

novel_features.name: Keyword / objection patterns
novel_features.description: Count and locate transcript mentions of a term, grouped by deal and stage.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 aggregate over the cached transcript corpus; the API offers no cross-call search.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to find where competitor mentions, pricing objections, or legal flags cluster.

narrative.headline: The first CLI for Sybill: every conversation, deal, and account in your terminal, plus a local store that answers cross-entity questions the web UI can't.
narrative.value_prop: Sybill records sales calls and generates AI summaries, deal briefs, and crmAutofill suggestions. This CLI pulls all of it into a local SQLite store you can query offline, then adds the joins the entity-by-entity API can't do: deals gone dark, a weekly call digest grouped by deal, pending crmAutofill diffs, and full-text transcript search.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create an API key in the Sybill dashboard under Settings > Integrations > API Keys (it starts with sk_live_), then set SYBILL_API_KEY. Run doctor to confirm the key is valid and the API is reachable. Read commands need a key with the read scope; ingest commands need the ingest scope (both are set on the key in the dashboard).

quickstart.comment: Confirm the API key is valid and see which scopes it carries
Pull conversations, deals, and accounts into the local store
Find open deals that have gone quiet
Build this week's call digest grouped by deal

troubleshoots.fix: SYBILL_API_KEY is unset or empty; export your sk_live_ key and re-run.
Your key is valid but lacks a needed scope (read or ingest). Regenerate the key in the Sybill dashboard with the scope the command needs.
Sybill allows 60 req/min; the client backs off automatically, but lower --limit or sync in smaller windows for large pulls.
Signed recording URLs expire after 24h; re-fetch the conversation detail to get fresh URLs.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or script needs Sybill call intelligence without the web UI: pulling call summaries and transcripts, answering pipeline-coverage questions across deals and conversations, reviewing crmAutofill suggestions before a CRM push, or grepping transcripts for objection and competitor patterns. It is the right tool any time the question spans more than one entity or needs offline, pipeable output.
